newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 14.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on February 14:
WASHINGTON - The head of the pilots' union at American Airlines said a strike against the nation's second largest carrier appeared "more probable than not."
WASHINGTON - Travellers with tickets on American Airlines who are headed for weekend respites to the ski slopes or beaches should expect some rattled nerves.
WASHINGTON - Banks and securities regulators told Congress that federal banking laws should be overhauled to suit the changing financial landscape.
